p.title: v59.97 the briefing opening no longer says an index fall sat in a few large stocks
p.symptom: When the equal-weight S&P 500 beat the cap-weighted index on a down day, the 오늘 opening said the fall was concentrated in a few large stocks (대형주 몇 곳에 몰렸고).
p.root_cause: indexLine reads only the cap-weighted and equal-weight index changes; their gap shows larger-cap names fell more than the average name, not that the fall sat in a few names.
p.fix: Both down-day branches now say the fall leaned more on the stocks with the larger market capitalisation (시가총액이 큰 종목에 더 실렸고); the rest of the sentence is unchanged.
p.violated_rule: A reading states only what its inputs show; no cause the data does not carry.
p.prevention: The existing v59.93 unit assertions on both branches keep passing; the claim of a few names is gone from the sentence source.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs exit 0. Not checked in a browser.

changelog: **Index-line cause ({P}):** on a day the equal-weight S&P 500 beat the index, the opening says the fall leaned on larger caps instead of claiming it sat in a few large stocks, which the two figures cannot show.
